summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Evaxion A/S, a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release announcing receipt of the Prix Galien UK Award for Best Digital Health Solution. The filing is a routine report of a non-financial, non-transactional achievement — a scientific/industry award recognition. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or any other special-situation transaction is described. The document contains no deal terms, no change in control, no board recommendation regarding a transaction, and no economic event. It is purely an informational update regarding an external validation award. As a routine current report without any special-situation event, this falls into the 'None' category.
